title: 발키리의 문
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 2, take B. ASGARD: golden winged gate and golden spired castle, surrounded by falling columns of light. Take B: a three-quarter view of one large freestanding fan-wing gate on a floating terrace; a compact castle rises immediately behind and slightly right, still all within the middle third's focal centre. A broad curving stair-causeway enters from lower left rather than a frontal straight bridge. Feathers spread laterally from the gate's gold posts, never a winged person. Low cloud horizon at y72%, immense uncluttered pale-blue sky, muted gold and blue-grey palette of realm reference. Upper-left light. Exactly three broad descending light shafts on either side, calm outer edges. No numeral or text-like carvings.
